title: Equipment & Vehicle Loans Deferral Terms by Product — Quick Reference
content:
| Product | Deferral available | Most deferrals over the life of one loan | Months that must pass after one deferral before another | Installments paid in full since funding before a first deferral | Calendar days before the due date by which the request must be registered | Deferral fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Truck & Trailer Loan | yes | 2 | 12 | 6 | 5 | 75 |
| EquipDirect Dealer Contract | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Used Equipment Loan | yes | 2 | 12 | 1 | 10 | 150 |
| New Equipment Loan | yes | 3 | 12 | 1 | 10 | 150 |
| Irrigation System Loan | yes | 2 | 12 | 1 | 15 | 250 |
| Grain Storage & Handling Loan | yes | 2 | 12 | 1 | 15 | 250 |

The table covers every product of Equipment & Vehicle Loans; deferral of an installment to the end of the schedule exists only on a product marked yes.

## Definitions

- **Deferral available** — whether an installment may be deferred to the end of the schedule.
- **Most deferrals** — the most deferrals over the life of one loan.
- **Spacing** — the calendar months that must pass after one deferral was granted before another may be granted.
- **Installments paid before a first deferral** — the installments that must have been paid in full since funding before a first deferral.
- **Request lead days** — the calendar days before the due date of the installment to be deferred by which the deferral request must be registered.
- **Deferral fee** — the fee per deferral granted, USD.

## Notes on the table

- The EquipDirect Dealer Contract offers no deferral; its zero figures mean the terms do not apply.
- The New Equipment Loan allows 3 deferrals over the life of a loan; the other products offering deferral allow 2.
- A Truck & Trailer Loan needs 6 installments paid in full since funding before its first deferral; the other products offering deferral need 1.
